description_en: Queries the list of hybrid cloud domain names
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-00000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name
parameters.help_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名
parameters.name: backend

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:

false: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾
parameters.name: cname_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group

Domains.description_en: The list of domain names returned

Cname.description_en:
The CNAME assigned by WAF to the domain name.
This parameter is returned only when CnameEnabled is set to true (public cloud disaster recovery is enabled)
Cname.description_zh:
WAF为域名分配的CNAME地址。
仅在CnameEnabled取值为true（表示开启公共云容灾）时，返回该参数

CipherSuite.description_en:
The type of cipher suite. Valid values:

1: all cipher suites are added.

2: strong cipher suites are added.

99: custom cipher suites are added
CipherSuite.description_zh:
加密套件类型。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件

CustomCiphers.description_en:
The specific custom cipher suites to add.

This parameter is returned only when CipherSuite is set to 99
CustomCiphers.description_zh:
要添加的具体自定义加密套件。

仅CipherSuite取值为99时，返回该参数

Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported
EnableTLSv3.description_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本

ExclusiveIp.description_en:
Indicates whether an exclusive IP address is supported. Valid values:
true: Supported.

false: Not supported
ExclusiveIp.description_zh:
是否支持独享IP。取值：
true：表示支持。

false：表示不支持

FocusHttps.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS forced redirect is enabled. Valid values:

true: HTTPS forced redirect is enabled.

false: HTTPS forced redirect is not enabled
FocusHttps.description_zh:
是否开启HTTPS的强制跳转。取值：

true：表示开启HTTPS的强制跳转。

false：表示不开启HTTPS的强制跳转

Http2Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled. Valid values:

true: HTTP/2 is enabled.

false: HTTP/2 is not enabled
Http2Enabled.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2。

false：表示不开启HTTP2

HttpPorts.description_en: The list of HTTP listening ports

IPv6Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is enabled. Valid values:

true: IPv6 is enabled.

false: IPv6 is not enabled
IPv6Enabled.description_zh:
开启IPv6是否开启IPv6。取值：

true：表示开启IPv6。

false：表示不开启IPv6

ProtectionResource.description_en:
The type of protection resource to use. Valid values:

share: shared cluster.

gslb: shared cluster with intelligent load balancing
ProtectionResource.description_zh:
要使用的防护资源类型。取值：

share：表示使用共享集群。

gslb：表示使用共享集群智能负载均衡

TLSVersion.description_en:
The TLS version. Valid values:

tlsv1

tlsv1.1

tlsv1.2
TLSVersion.description_zh:
TLS的版本。取值：

tlsv1

tlsv1.1

tlsv1.2

XffHeaderMode.description_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: No Layer 7 proxy is deployed in front of WAF.

1: WAF reads the first value of the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header field as the client IP address.

2: WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address.

3: WAF reads the Client IP from the Proxy Protocol header as the client IP address
XffHeaderMode.description_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

3：表示WAF读取Proxy Protocol头中的Client IP作为客户端IP

XffHeaders.description_en:
The list of custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format of ["header1","header2",...].

This parameter is returned only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2 (WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify in the request header as the client IP address)
XffHeaders.description_zh:
用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，返回该参数

items.description_en: The custom header field used to obtain the client IP address
items.description_zh: 用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表

Backends.description_en: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name
Backends.description_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名

items.description_en: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name
items.description_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名

CnameEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether public cloud disaster recovery is enabled. Valid values:

true: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

false: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled
CnameEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾

ConnectTimeout.description_en: The connection timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 120
ConnectTimeout.description_zh:
连接超时时长。单位：秒。
取值范围：5~120

FocusHttpBackend.description_en:
Indicates whether forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled. Valid values:

true: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled.

false: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is not enabled
FocusHttpBackend.description_zh:
是否开启强制HTTP回源。取值：

true：表示开启强制HTTP回源。

false：表示不开启强制HTTP回源

Keepalive.description_en:
Indicates whether persistent connections are enabled. Valid values:

true: Persistent connections are enabled.

false: Persistent connections are not enabled
Keepalive.description_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接

KeepaliveRequests.description_en:
The number of requests that reuse persistent connections. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

Specifies how many requests can reuse persistent connections after persistent connections are enabled
KeepaliveRequests.description_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en:
The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds.

Specifies how long an idle persistent connection is kept alive before it is released
KeepaliveTimeout.description_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：1~60，默认15，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多久后释放

Loadbalance.description_en:
The load balancing algorithm used for back-to-origin. Valid values:

iphash: IP Hash algorithm.

roundRobin: round-robin algorithm.

leastTime: Least Time algorithm
Loadbalance.description_zh:
回源时采用的负载均衡算法。取值：

iphash：表示IP Hash算法。

roundRobin：表示轮询算法。

leastTime：表示Least Time算法

ReadTimeout.description_en: The read timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 1800
ReadTimeout.description_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：5~1800

RequestHeaders.description_en: The traffic mark header fields and values of the domain name, used to mark traffic processed by WAF
RequestHeaders.description_zh: 域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量

items.description_en: The traffic mark header fields and values of the domain name, used to mark traffic processed by WAF
items.description_zh: 域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量

Key.description_en: The specified custom request header field
Key.description_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段

Value.description_en: The value of the specified custom request header field
Value.description_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段设定的值

Retry.description_en:
Indicates whether WAF retries when back-to-origin fails. Valid values:

true: WAF retries.

false: WAF does not retry
Retry.description_zh:
WAF回源失败时，是否重试。取值：

true：表示重试。

false：表示不重试

RoutingRules.description_en:
The hybrid cloud forwarding rules, represented as a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a structure that contains the following fields:
rs: Array type. The list of back-to-origin IP addresses or back-to-origin CNAMEs.

location: String type. The name of the protection node.

locationId: Long type. The ID of the protection node
RoutingRules.description_zh:
混合云转发规则。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：
rs：Array类型 | 表示回源IP地址或者回源CNAME列表

location：String类型 | 表示防护节点名称

locationId：Long类型 | 表示防护节点ID

SniEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether back-to-origin Server Name Indication (SNI) is enabled. Valid values:

true: Back-to-origin SNI is enabled.

false: Back-to-origin SNI is not enabled
SniEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启回源SNI。取值：

true：表示开启回源SNI。

false：表示不开启回源SNI

SniHost.description_en:
The custom value of the SNI extension field. An empty value indicates that no custom SNI value is set. By default, the value of the Host field in the request header is used as the value of the SNI extension field.

This parameter is returned only when SniEnabled is set to true (back-to-origin SNI is enabled)
SniHost.description_zh:
SNI扩展字段的自定义值。取值为空表示未自定义SNI值，默认使用请求头中Host字段的值作为SNI扩展字段的值。

仅在SniEnabled取值为true（表示开启SNI回源）时，返回该参数

WriteTimeout.description_en: The write timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 1800
WriteTimeout.description_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：5~1800

ResourceManagerResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group

Status.description_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

1: The domain name is in a normal state.

2: The domain name is being created.

3: The domain name is being modified.

4: The domain name is being released.

5: The domain name has stopped forwarding traffic
Status.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

1：表示域名处于正常状态。

2：表示域名创建中。

3：表示域名修改中。

4：表示域名释放中。

5：表示域名停止转发

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
